results.rationale: Consistency: The left chopstick, its ivory handle, both original wooden shafts, spacing, and white background remain visually unchanged. Instruction: The previously truncated right shaft gains a full-length brown handle; a complete continuous handle is expected, and the extension supplies it, with a slightly uneven join where it meets the old shaft. No handle color was explicitly specified. Quality: Structure, lighting, and wood surfaces are coherent; a small lumpy color/edge transition on the right stick is the sole noticeable imperfection.

Consistency: The left ivory handle becomes wood, both pointed shafts are reshaped with rounder tips, and wood grain and shadows change; the two-stick arrangement and white backdrop persist. Instruction: The short right chopstick is extended to a complete handle with a clean terminal end, satisfying the requested completion; no particular handle color was specified. Quality: Both wooden sticks have continuous clean silhouettes, plausible grain, coherent shadows, and no noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: The two separated tapered chopsticks are replaced by one centered, nearly parallel-sided rod, changing count, arrangement, silhouettes, and the ivory-handle configuration; only the plain backdrop remains broadly similar. Instruction: The image substitutes a new single rod with a tiny pale top cap instead of completing the missing handle on the supplied right chopstick, so the requested modification is not realized. Quality: The isolated rod has plausible wood texture and illumination, but a small abrupt notch in its middle interrupts an otherwise straight edge.

Consistency: The original pair and its spacing are replaced by a single centered blunt-ended stick; original pointed shaft geometry and composition are lost, although wood/ivory materials and a white background remain. Instruction: A long ivory lower handle is present, which addresses the completion idea, but the supplied incomplete chopstick is substantially replaced and the original pointed upper portion is not retained; this is a major omission. Quality: The single two-material object has a clean continuous silhouette, a tidy joint, coherent surfaces and soft shading, with no noticeable artifacts.
